frame.about: x east, y north, metres from the Maps pin 19.1692159 N 73.0017703 E; glTF is Y-up: three (x, y, z) = rtp_local (x, height above the level-6 finished floor, -y). Not recentred.

asset.element_attribute: _ELEMENT (per vertex, float): the index into elements[]; -1 on review markers. three.js exposes it as geometry.attributes._element

asset.review_marker_text: Text labels retained in editable Blender scene. Web asset keeps marker posts/rings; reasons remain in manifest.
asset.load_test: Actual vendored GLTFLoader: 63 meshes and _element attributes, one ceiling, one review-marker mesh. Browser render tested separately.
